resources.string: Edit a draft, then apply it as one Undo. Closing discards unapplied changes.
Length: %1$d bars / %2$d steps on this grid

Remove those notes from the draft
Display window · does not change pattern length
Changing the grid keeps existing notes. Triplets divide each beat into 3 or 6 steps. All note positions follow the song’s swing.
This PAD has no sound. Assign a sound or choose another PAD.
Scroll the row horizontally to reach every step on the selected grid.
Selected PAD: %1$d notes, %2$d off the selected grid
Quantize this PAD · collisions keep the strongest note
Queue saved patterns in order. Placement adds rendered clips; later pattern edits do not change those clips. Starts follow BPM and swing. The rendered sound keeps its duration.

Steps trigger notes without note-off: GATE plays to its natural end. At the queued range end, every voice including LOOP stops with a fade of up to 96 frames (2 ms at 48 kHz). The end bar is exclusive.
Add saved pattern to the queue
Track: %1$s · bars %2$d to %3$d, plus stop fade
Discard draft and reload current project

Check the name, length and placement values.

The placement exceeds the current audio memory or asset limit. The song is unchanged.

Apply or discard this draft before selecting or placing a pattern.

Finish recording before editing or placing patterns.
